title: MCP finds more models and checks your Pollen
summary:
MCP gained a wider model menu and account tools, while Play, model browsing, and mobile key dialogs got a practical tidy-up.

The MCP package now validates models and voices against the gateway registries instead of short fixed lists. Its video tools accept nine listed models, audio tools can use more than 35 voices, and speech tools accept an audio-model override. New account tools let an authorized key check its Pollen balance and request usage.

Visitors can still browse the full Play model catalog while logged out, but generating now starts the login flow rather than using a shared anonymous key. Play also distinguishes server-side secret keys from BYOP App Keys.

Enter’s model cards and pricing rows gained provider logos, status badges, copyable API model keys, and clearer mobile details. TTS prices now appear as estimated per-second rates; public model keys and routing did not change.

daily.title: More choices in MCP
daily.text: MCP video tools now accept nine registry-listed models, and audio tools can use more than 35 voices. Speech tools also let you override the audio model. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Check Pollen from MCP
daily.text: Use the new `getBalance` and `getUsage` tools to check your Pollen balance and request or daily usage with an authorized key. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).
